name: Buy Me a Coffee
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Receives Buy Me a Coffee webhooks and fires triggers when someone buys you a coffee, joins a membership, or cancels one.

functions.name: Handle Buy Me a Coffee Webhook

settings.label: Buy Me a Coffee signing secret
settings.description: Shown when you create the webhook in Buy Me a Coffee. Requests not signed with it are refused.

triggers.name: Buy Me a Coffee webhook
triggers.description: Paste this URL into Buy Me a Coffee's webhook settings. Every request is checked against your signing secret before anything fires.

triggers.name: Buy Me a Coffee support
triggers.description: Fires when someone buys you a coffee.
